draft_en.subject: Industrial fibre switches - DIN-rail 8 + 2 SFP, and the BIS question
draft_en.body:
Hello Amity team,

Over the past months you had a product mail from us - "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 20 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial fibre switches you were looking at: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS - model STI-280GE - $46 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP version - STI-288GP - $59.8. SFP modules we do not supply.

One question: do your Indian projects require BIS-registered units, or is CE/RoHS sufficient for your end customers?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
